---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  add_count(Activity) |>
  filter(n >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(fct_infreq(Activity)), fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fatal" = "firebrick",
                               "Non-fatal" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal and non-fatal shark attacks by activity",
    subtitle = "Activities with at least 50 incidents; unknown outcomes left out",
    x = "Number of attacks",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Global Shark Attack File"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
